name: ayland
description: AYLAND: AI travel companion for Mongolian travelers (Team Morgensonne). See HANDBOOK.md.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && uv --directory backend sync
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,travel,merchant,booking,interp -c magenta,cyan,green,blue,yellow,red "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm run api" "npm run mcp:travel" "npm run mcp:merchant" "npm run agent:booking" "npm run agent:interpreter"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && uv --directory backend run ruff check .
